# OBS020 `deprecated-mpi-include`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

`include 'mpif.h'` instead of the `mpi_f08` module.

## Why

`mpif.h` declares no interfaces: no MPI call is checked by the compiler, and it is deprecated by the
MPI standard (4.1). `use mpi_f08` gives type-checked, `ierror`-optional bindings.

## Reported

```fortran
include 'mpif.h'
```

## Preferred

```fortran
use mpi_f08
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OBS020] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OBS020` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
